data.name: Reaver
data.baseSource: v1.10.26 card photos from r/StarCraftTMG (2026-11-25); may be pre-release

abilities.name: Large
abilities.text: When this Unit's Leading Model moves, it cannot pass through physical gaps smaller than 3″ wide, regardless of its size. If the Leading Model's path of travel passes through, or any model in this Unit ends its movement on a Size 0 or Size 1 Impassable Terrain piece (excluding Tokens) during any movement action, that terrain piece is immediately removed from the game.

abilities.name: Limited Artificial Intelligence
abilities.text: If this Unit is a parent to any SUMMONED Unit, it cannot SUMMON another one.

abilities.name: Microfactory
abilities.text: This Unit's Scarab Special Ability can be used this Round even if it was already used.

abilities.name: Scarab
abilities.text: Once per Game. Resolve the SUMMON (Scarab) effect. Then, the Scarab may immediately perform a Move action.

abilities.name: Siege Triangulation
abilities.text: Move a Scarab, Solarite Scarab or Phasing Scarab created by this Unit up to 5″.

abilities.name: Indomitable
abilities.text: While Engaged, this Unit may target and be targeted by Unengaged Enemy Units. In both cases, the defending Unit gains an Evade Roll against those attacks.

upgrades.name: Solarite Scarab
upgrades.text: Once per Game. Resolve the SUMMON (Solarite Scarab) effect. Then, the Solarite Scarab may immediately perform a Move action.

upgrades.name: Phasing Scarab
upgrades.text: Once per Game. Resolve the SUMMON (Phasing Scarab) effect. Then, the Phasing Scarab may immediately perform a Move action.

upgrades.name: Shuttle
upgrades.text: Once per Game. This ability can be used while this Unit is in Reserves. Set a Faction Indicator anywhere on the battlefield more than 10″ away from any Enemy model. At the End of the Round, the controlling player may Deploy this Unit in base-to-base contact with this Faction Indicator. This Unit's Activation ends.
